verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच। न वै निर्गुणमात्मानं मन्ये देवर्षिसत्तम। तथास्मि दुःखसंतप्तो यथा नान्यो महीपतिः॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said : O foremost of celestials Rishis, I do not think that I am not endued with some merit. But I am still afflicted with so much sorrow that (I believe) there is no other king like me.

verses.sanskrit: परांश्च निर्गुणान्मन्ये न च धर्मगतानपि। ते च लोमश लोकेऽस्मिन्नृध्यन्ते केन हेतुना॥२॥
verses.english: O Lomasha, I think my enemies have no merit and no virtuous tendencies. Why then do they proper in this world?

verses.sanskrit: लोमश उवाच। नात्र दुःखं त्वया राजन्कार्यं पार्थ कथंचन। यदधर्मेण वर्धेयुरधर्मरुचयो जनाः॥३॥
verses.english: Lomasha said : O king, O Partha, never grieve that sinful men should prosper in consequence of the sins they commit.

verses.sanskrit: वर्धत्यधर्मेण नरस्ततो भद्राणि पश्यति। ततः सपत्नाञ्जयति समूलस्तु विनश्यति॥४॥
verses.english: A man may be seen to prosper by his sins, obtain good fruits or vanquish his enemies, but he is finally destroyed to the root.

verses.sanskrit: मया हि दृष्टा दैतेया दानवाश्च महीपते। वर्धमाना ह्यधर्मेण क्षयं चोपगताः पुनः॥५॥
verses.english: O ruler of earth, I have seen many Daityas and Danavas prosper by sin, but I have also seen that destruction has again ever taken them.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा देवयुगे चैव दृष्टं सर्वं मया विभो। अरोचयन्सुरा धर्मं धर्मं तत्यजिरेऽसुराः॥६॥
verses.english: O lord, I have seen all this formerly in the Deva Yuga. The celestials practised virtue whereas the Asuras practised sin.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानि देवा विविशुर्नाविशन्भारतासुराः। तानधर्मकृतो दर्पः पूर्वमेव समाविशत्॥७॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, the celestials visited the Tirthas whereas the Asuras did not visit them. Those sinful ones were first filled with pride.

verses.sanskrit: दर्पान्मानः समभवन्मानात्क्रोधो व्यजायत। क्रोधादह्रीस्ततोऽलञ्जा वृत्तं तेषां ततोऽनशत्॥८॥
verses.english: Pride begot vanity and vanity begot wealth. From wealth arose every king of evil propensity and from evil propensities arose shamelessness.
verses.bhavadeepa: विविशुः स्नानार्थमिति शेषः । अधर्मस्तीर्थयात्राऽप्रवेशजस्तत्कर्तॄन् अधर्मकृतः । अधर्मेण कृत उत्पादितो वा दर्पः गर्वः ततो मानः पूज्योऽस्मीति बुद्धिः ॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: तानलज्जान्गतह्रीकान्हीनवृत्तान्वृथाव्रतान्। क्षमा लक्ष्मीः स्वधर्मश्च न चिरात्प्रजहुस्ततः॥९॥
verses.english: From shamelessness good behaviour disappeared from among them. From their shamelessness, from their evil propensities, from their want of good conduct and virtuous vows, forgiveness, propensity and morality all forsook them.
verses.bhavadeepa: ततः पूजाया अलाभे प्रतिघाते वा क्रोधः ततः अह्रीः अकार्ये प्रवृत्तिः ततः अलज्जा लज्जानिन्द्यतादोषाद्भयं तस्य नाशः ॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीस्तु देवानगमदलक्ष्मीरसुरान्नृप। तानलक्ष्मीसमाविष्टान्दर्पोपहतचेतसः॥१०॥
verses.english: O king, Lakshmi (the goddess of prosperity) then sought the celestials while a Lakshmi (goddess of adversity) sought the Asuras. When they were possessed by adversity they became senseless out of pride.

verses.sanskrit: दैतेयान्दानवांश्चैव कलिरप्याविशत्ततः। तानलक्ष्मीसमाविष्टान्दानवान्कलिना हतान्॥११॥
verses.english: Then Kali possessed the Daityas and the Danavas. Being thus possessed by adversity, the Danavas were destroyed by Kali.

verses.sanskrit: दर्पाभिभूतान्कौन्तेय क्रियाहीनानचेतसः। मानाभिभूतानचिराद्विनाशः समपद्यत॥१२॥
verses.english: O son of Kunti, as they were filled with pride they became destitute of rites and sacrifices, devoid of reason, overwhelmed with vanity and they soon met with their destruction.

verses.sanskrit: निर्यशस्कास्तथा दैत्याः कृत्स्नशो विलयं गताः। देवास्तु सागरांश्चैव सरितश्च सरांसि च॥१३॥
verses.english: Covered with infamy the Daityas were soon destroyed. O son of Pandu, the celestials, however, who were all of virtuous character, going to the seas, rivers and lakes and other sacred places, cleansed themselves of all their sins by means of asceticism and sacrifices, by gifts and blessings; and O Pandava, they obtained great prosperity. Because they thus abandoned all evil deeds and practised all good deeds,

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यगच्छन्धर्मशीलाः पुण्यान्यावतनानि च। तपोभिः क्रतुभिर्दानैराशीर्वादैश्च पाण्डव॥१४॥
प्रजहुः सर्वपापानि श्रेयश्च प्रतिपेदिरे। एवमादानवन्तश्च निरादानाश्च सर्वशः॥१५॥
तीर्थान्यगच्छन्विबुधास्तेनापुर्भूतिमुत्तमाम्। तथा त्वमपि राजेन्द्र स्नात्वा तीर्थेषु सानुजः॥१६॥
verses.english: And visited all the Tirthas, they obtained great good fortune. O king of kings, you will too therefore, bathing with your younger brothers in the Tirthas, obtain again great good fortune. This is the eternal road.
verses.bhavadeepa: आदानवन्तः आर्जवादिनियमग्रहणवन्तः निरादानाः अप्रतिबद्धाः सर्वशः देवादिभिरपि ॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्वेत्स्वसि तां लक्ष्मीमेष पन्थाः सनातनः। यथैव हि नृगो राजा शिबिरौशीनरो यथा॥१७॥
verses.english: As kings, Nriga, Shibi, Ushinara, Bhagiratha, Vasumana, Gaya, Puru and Pururava, by always practising austerities and touching the sacred waters and visiting the Tirthas and seeing the illustrious holy men, O king, obtained fame, virtue and great wealth.

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथो वसुमना गयः पूरुः पुरूरवाः। चरमाणास्तपो नित्यं स्पर्शनादम्भसश्च ते॥१८॥
तीर्थाभिगमनात्पूता दर्शनाच्च महात्मनाम्। अलभन्त यशः पुण्यं धनानि च विशांपते॥१९॥
तथा त्वमपि राजेन्द्र लब्ध्वा सुविपुलां श्रियम्। यथा चेक्ष्वाकुरभवत्सपुत्रजनबान्धवः॥२०॥
verses.english: So will you obtain by acquiring exceedingly great prosperity. As Ikshvaku with his sons, friends and followers, Muchukunda, Mandhata and king Maruta, as the celestials through their power of asceticism, as the celestials Rishis also have obtained fame, so will you also obtain great fame. The sons of Dhritarashtra, enslaved as they are by sin and ignorance, will certainly be destroyed like Daityas. as

verses.sanskrit: मुचुकुन्दोथ मांधाता मरुत्तश्च महीपतिः। कीर्तिं पुण्यामविन्दन्त यथा देवास्तपोबलात्॥२१॥
देवर्षयश्च कार्त्स्न्येन तथा त्वमपि वेत्स्यसि। धार्तराष्ट्रास्त्वधर्मेण मोहेन च वशीकृताः। न चिराद्वै विनङ्क्ष्यन्ति दैत्या इव न संशयः॥२२॥
